task_summary: Customer requests an exchange of Premium Cotton Shirt from order ORD-6034 for the same shirt in Large. Correct handling: apply exchange policy, preview the exchange, get customer confirmation, then process payment difference or issue store credit as per policy.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the exchange policy before handling the exchange request.
Agent must make a process_exchange preview tool call for ITEM-9250 to PROD-2251 with confirm false or omitted before making the confirm=true process_exchange tool call.

opening_message: I'd like to exchange the Premium Cotton Shirt from order ORD-6034 for the Premium Cotton Shirt in size Large.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are the customer who wants to exchange Premium Cotton Shirt from order ORD-6034 for the same style in Large. If the agent provides a valid exchange preview and asks for confirmation, agree to proceed.
known_info: You purchased a Premium Cotton Shirt under order ORD-6034.
You now want the same shirt in size Large.
unknown_info: You are not aware of the exchange price-difference policy.
task_rules: Do not request any other product during the exchange.
Confirm the exchange once a valid preview is given.
